rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it overstates certainty from a single static image by claiming clearly visible cohesive TE, uniform zona thinning, visible nuclei/nucleoli, and no collapse/artifact or degeneration—features not reliably discernible here.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, AMH discordance, PCOS, BMI, prior ectopic, sperm parameters, endometrium, and transfer timing into prognosis and management.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the case; minor issues include some speculative links (PCOS receptivity penalty, AMH paradox emphasis) and slight overconfidence in morphology-derived conclusions.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, single good-quality blastocyst prognosis, and ectopic surveillance, but recommendations such as ERA after a second failed transfer, routine PGT-A consideration at age 27, and adjunctive dydrogesterone/metformin are more controversial or not guideline-standard.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer technique, post-transfer monitoring, tubal evaluation, and contingency planning for future cycles with good case-specific nuance.
